author: DalordTroop
quote:
I think the fact that they took to much f**king time to release this would make the game great. I think this game is boring af for the first hour and if someone thinks "you need to get to the best part to like it", no. Its like watching the whole twilight saga jus to get to the fight between the vulturi and the rest. I truly hoped GTA6 would be modern time RDR2. 
The characters have no richbackstory whatsoever
Characters are not interesting at all
Poor character development
Poor game story

Im so enraged about how bad this game was in comparison of the hype ROCKSTAR gave that I could go all week, but i'll just leave it at that, I just dont know what tf happened to modernday games. You know what was great? The mechanics and resolution in the game. Just that, because they sell you this game like "oh look, every action has its own animation", bro its the minimum for a freaking multimillionaire studio with more than 10 years of prep time. 

My real rate would be 4/10 but I give it a 0 for the hype Rockstar created.
